title: Apply Coupon stops working after five presses on /cart

summary.text: Shoppers press Apply Coupon on the bag page and, after it has worked a few times, nothing happens: no discount, no message.

likely_cause.text: The coupon handler stops reacting after repeated use: no DOM change, navigation, or request follows the later presses.

repro_steps.step: Add an item to the bag and open /cart.
Type a coupon code and press Apply Coupon six or more times, about a second apart.
From the sixth press on, the button does nothing.
